name: The Trinket Lord

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: Small creatures occupy the same space as Medium creatures, but they face some restrictions in the weapons they can wield: • You can’t use two-handed weapons, such as greatswords and halberds. • When you use a versatile weapon, such as a longsword, you must use it two-handed, but you don’t deal additional damage for doing so.

traits.name: Nullifying Aura
traits.details: Enemies in the aura cannot use magic item powers, other than powers of consumable items.

traits.name: Indomitable Spirit
traits.details: Any dominating or stunning effect on the Trinket Lord ends at the start of his turn.

traits.name: Magic Item Mastery
traits.details: Whenever the Trinket Lord attacks, choose two of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, psychic, thunder, or radiant. The damage dealt by the attack changes to the chosen types.

auras.name: Nullifying Aura
auras.details: Enemies in the aura cannot use magic item powers, other than powers of consumable items.

powers.name: Gnomish Tactics
powers.requirements: The Trinket Lord must be invisible.

effect.description: The Trinket Lord uses activate magic item twice.

miss.description: Half damage, and ongoing 5 damage (save ends).

effect.description: The Trinket Lord becomes invisible until the end of his current turn or until he hits or misses with an attack.

The Trinket Lord alters his physical form to appear as a Tiny fox until he uses change shape again or until he drops to 0 hit points. While in this form, he takes no penalty to Stealth checks for moving up to his speed, and he gains a +10 power bonus to Stealth checks. He can make no attacks in this form.

powers.name: Fey Resolve
powers.trigger: The Trinket Lord is first bloodied.

effect.description: Sunder relic recharges, and the Trinket Lord uses it. He then becomes invisible until the end of his next turn or until he hits or misses with an attack.
